scope: clean-traps/ (whole project: package.json, tsconfig.json, src/Steps.tsx, src/Field.tsx, src/Counter.tsx, src/Dialog.tsx)
limitations: Project is React 18 with no Next.js dependency and no framework config, so the Next.js rules were not applied.

Color contrast, focus appearance, screen-reader output and runtime behaviour cannot be verified from source alone.
No stylesheets, assets, test files or build output were present to review.
